llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward bug-review workflow; its main caveat is that its broad trigger words may cause it to activate in ordinary coding conversations.

dimensions.detail: The requested activities, including reading project manifests, reviewing code, running tests, and running static analyzers, are proportionate to bug review and are disclosed in the workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown-only and does not contain install scripts, executable code, package downloads, or automatic setup steps; it only references an upstream plugin for a fuller experience.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as bugs, fixes, and verification, which may activate the workflow more often than intended, but the runtime instructions remain aligned with bug investigation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, credential handling, memory writes, tool hijacking, or destructive system changes were found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe code bug review, reproduction planning, defect documentation, minimal fixes, tests, and verification, with no unrelated data access or hidden behavior found.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that this skill may activate for general words like fixes or verification. Its instructions are otherwise typical for a bug-review assistant: it may inspect code, propose changes, and run project test or lint commands when the user directs that workflow.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger terms are a real quality and activation-scope concern, but the inspected artifacts do not show hidden behavior, high-impact authority, or purpose-mismatched actions that would require Review.
